name: Leaky Brooke Farm
tagline: Link to Leaky Brooke Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/leaky.farm/
description: A small pumpkin patch in 915 Co Rd 330, AL, Leaky Brooke Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
